import os,glob,re
def load():

        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    dirs=[(1,1),(1,-1),(1,0),(0,1)]
    seen=set()
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            for dr,dc in dirs:
                # line through (r,c) in this direction
                cells=[]
                rr,cc=r-dr,c-dc
                while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and g[rr][cc]!=0:
                    cells.append((rr,cc)); rr-=dr; cc-=dc
                cells.reverse(); cells.append((r,c))
                rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
                while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and g[rr][cc]!=0:
                    cells.append((rr,cc)); rr+=dr; cc+=dc
                if len(cells)<2: continue
                for cell in cells: seen.add(cell)
                from collections import Counter
                cnt=Counter(g[a][b] for a,b in cells)
                col,n=cnt.most_common(1)[0]
                if n<2 or len(cnt)<2: continue
                # find run of col cells; blocker on one end
                idx=[i for i,(a,b) in enumerate(cells) if g[a][b]==col]
                if idx!=[i for i in range(idx[0],idx[0]+len(idx))]: continue
                lo,hi=idx[0],idx[-1]
                if lo>0: # blocker before
                    a,b=cells[hi]; rr,cc=a+dr,b+dc
                    while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W:
                        g[rr][cc]=col; rr+=dr; cc+=dc
                elif hi<len(cells)-1: # blocker after
                    a,b=cells[lo]; rr,cc=a-dr,b-dc
                    while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W:
                        g[rr][cc]=col; rr-=dr; cc-=dc
    return g

from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    def line(dr,dc,r,c):
        cells=[(r,c)]
        rr,cc=r-dr,c-dc
        while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and g[rr][cc]!=bg:
            cells.append((rr,cc)); rr-=dr; cc-=dc
        cells.reverse()
        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and g[rr][cc]!=bg:
            cells.append((rr,cc)); rr+=dr; cc+=dc
        return cells
    edits=[]
    doneset=set()
    for dr,dc in [(1,1),(1,-1),(1,0),(0,1)]:
        for r in range(H):
            for c in range(W):
                if g[r][c]==bg: continue
                # only process each line once: cell must be line start
                pr,pc=r-dr,c-dc
                if 0<=pr<H and 0<=pc<W and g[pr][pc]!=bg: continue
                cells=line(dr,dc,r,c)
                if len(cells)<2: continue
                key=(dr,dc,cells[0])
                if key in doneset: continue
                doneset.add(key)
                for end,step in ((0,-1),(len(cells)-1,1)):
                    col=g[cells[end][0]][cells[end][1]]
                    i=end
                    while 0<=i<len(cells) and g[cells[i][0]][cells[i][1]]==col: i+=step
                    run=abs(i-end)
                    if run>=2 and 1<=i<len(cells):
                        a,b=cells[end]; rr,cc=a+dr*step,b+dc*step
                        while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W:
                            edits.append((rr,cc,col)); rr+=dr*step; cc+=dc*step
    for r,c,col in edits: g[r][c]=col
    return g
